schemaVersion.description:
SchemaVersion is the manifest format version, "evidence-manifest/v1".
Optional; when absent, version 1 is assumed.

tool.description: Tool is the program that produced the artifact, such as "govulncheck".

toolVersion.description: ToolVersion is the tool's version string.

generatedAt.description: GeneratedAt is when the artifact was produced, in RFC 3339.

databaseUpdatedAt.description:
DatabaseUpdatedAt is when the tool's vulnerability database or rule set
was last updated, in RFC 3339, for tools that have one.

artifactPath.description: ArtifactPath is the artifact file, relative to the manifest's directory.

sha256.description: SHA256 is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the artifact.

mediaType.description:
MediaType is the artifact's media type, such as
"application/vnd.cyclonedx+json".

target.description: Target is what the artifact is about.

mentions.description:
Mentions lists the IDs of systems whose names appear in the artifact's
content, so views can withhold it from other systems' audiences.

controls.description:
Controls lists control IDs the artifact supports, as a hint; a
compliance engine decides what it supports.

Manifest.description: Manifest is the metadata a collector writes once beside each evidence artifact.

system.description: System is the ID of a system (a product) in the scope document.

platform.description: Platform is the ID of a shared platform in the scope document.

components.description: Components lists component IDs within the system or platform.

revision.description: Revision is the source revision or release the artifact describes.

environment.description: Environment is the deployment environment, such as "staging" or "prod".

Target.description: Target identifies what an artifact is about.

title: Evidence manifest
description: Metadata a collector writes once beside each evidence artifact: provenance, freshness inputs, scope and integrity.
